findings.highlight: it shouldn’t matter how I do it
findings.evidenceJa: なりふり構っている場合じゃない
findings.governingReading: he cannot afford to worry about appearances or propriety
findings.explanation: The English broadens desperation about maintaining appearances into indifference toward any method whatsoever.

findings.evidenceJa: 令呪もなくなった
findings.governingReading: his Command Spells are gone
findings.explanation: The visible set of command marks is singularized again.

findings.evidenceJa: 肝心な事を忘れてた
findings.governingReading: Rin had forgotten the crucial point
findings.explanation: The importance she assigns to Shirou’s changed status is removed.

findings.highlight: Her words are merely something she must ask as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: あくまで平等に、自分の意志を混ぜず、マスターとして問いかけた言葉
findings.governingReading: she asks impartially as a Master, without mixing in her own will
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberate neutral stance becomes an externally imposed obligation to ask.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分の意志を混ぜず
findings.governingReading: without mixing in her own will
findings.explanation: The distinction between outward neutrality and private volition becomes absence of personal concern.

findings.highlight: She’s providing me with a chance to back out
findings.evidenceJa: 身を引いて帰り道を用意してくれている
findings.governingReading: she steps aside and prepares a path by which he can go home
findings.explanation: The physical and metaphorical generosity of Rin making room for retreat is reduced to an abstract chance.

findings.highlight: I’ll still make it if I want to withdraw
findings.evidenceJa: 戻るのならまだ間に合う
findings.governingReading: there is still time if he chooses to turn back
findings.explanation: The English uses an unclear success idiom rather than the remaining opportunity to withdraw.

findings.evidenceJa: いや
findings.governingReading: No
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces Shirou’s terse rejection of the offered retreat with an explicit declaration supplied by the following explanation.

findings.evidenceJa: 今はその心遣いだけを、忘れないように覚えていよう
findings.governingReading: for now he will remember that consideration alone and make sure not to forget it
findings.explanation: The private, carefully bounded acknowledgment of Rin’s kindness loses its temporal and exclusive limits and gains a contrastive “though.”

findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちの関係も続行
findings.governingReading: their existing relationship will continue
findings.explanation: The English sounds romantic or possessive rather than referring cleanly to the operational truce.

findings.evidenceJa: なんの前触れもなく遠坂は笑った
findings.governingReading: without any warning, Tohsaka smiles
findings.explanation: The absence of any visible transition from her neutral mask is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: さっきの無表情さが嘘のように親しげ
findings.governingReading: she feels so friendly that her earlier expressionlessness seems unreal
findings.explanation: The transformation revealing Rin’s relief is reduced to a static friendly appearance.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の知るところじゃないからいい
findings.governingReading: it lies outside what Shirou can know, so he lets it pass
findings.explanation: Epistemic distance becomes emotional indifference.

findings.evidenceJa: 無欲な人間
findings.governingReading: people without personal desire
findings.explanation: Lack of desire is moralized into altruistic virtue, obscuring Rin’s warning about susceptibility to outside motives.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分以外のものに引きずられる
findings.governingReading: pulled along by things outside oneself
findings.explanation: The range of external goals and circumstances that can move Shirou is narrowed to other persons.

findings.evidenceJa: 仕方なく聖杯を使う
findings.governingReading: he might use the Grail because circumstances leave no choice
findings.explanation: Reluctant constrained action becomes inevitability.

findings.evidenceJa: 今まで通りでしょ
findings.governingReading: they would be enemies just as they have been until now
findings.explanation: The continuity Rin treats as ordinary is reduced to bare current status.

findings.highlight: She looks at me as if she’s seen a ghost
findings.evidenceJa: お化けをみるような目で、まじまじと俺を見た
findings.governingReading: she stares fixedly at him as though looking at a ghost
findings.explanation: The sustained scrutiny showing how completely Shirou’s request surprises Rin is omitted.

findings.highlight: I need you as an ally
findings.evidenceJa: 休戦するんじゃなくて、協力者として助力してほしい
findings.governingReading: he wants her help as a collaborator rather than merely a truce
findings.explanation: The central distinction Shirou is negotiating is collapsed into a generic label.

findings.highlight: Equivalent exchange is standard for magi
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の基本は等価交換
findings.governingReading: equivalent exchange is a basic principle of magecraft
findings.explanation: A rule about the practice is reassigned to the people as a social custom.

findings.highlight: I can’t help someone who can’t help me in return
findings.evidenceJa: 釣りあわない技術者に手を貸す事も出来ない
findings.governingReading: one cannot lend assistance to a practitioner whose skill or standing is not commensurate
findings.explanation: Rin’s analogy about mismatched technical partners becomes simple reciprocal favor exchange.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉を濁す
findings.governingReading: makes her words evasive or trails off
findings.explanation: Even within the improperly activated variant, Rin’s verbal evasion is mistranslated as low volume.

findings.highlight: I’m fully aware that I’m only a burden on her
findings.evidenceJa: 迷惑だって事は百も承知だ
findings.governingReading: he knows perfectly well that the request is an imposition
findings.explanation: A judgment about the inconvenience of asking becomes a global self-description as Rin’s burden.

findings.highlight: I can trust her to do no wrong even if she obtains the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を得るのが遠坂なら、何の間違いも起きないと信じられる
findings.governingReading: he trusts that nothing disastrous or mistaken will occur if Rin is the one who obtains the Grail
findings.explanation: Confidence in one specific outcome becomes blanket moral infallibility, while “even if” makes Rin obtaining it sound adverse.

findings.evidenceJa: 一度、大きく俯いて
findings.governingReading: Rin lowers her head deeply once
findings.explanation: The magnitude of her embarrassed withdrawal before accepting terms is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 真っ直ぐにこっちを見返してきた
findings.governingReading: she sharply meets his gaze straight on
findings.explanation: The reciprocal recovery from looking down is reduced to hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: 考えてあげないコトもない
findings.governingReading: it is not impossible that she might consider it for him
findings.explanation: Rin’s layered double-negative hedge is made a straightforward commitment.

findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず聞く
findings.governingReading: for now, he will hear her out
findings.explanation: Shirou’s provisional assent before knowing the conditions is made unqualified.
